Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. Public Affairs & Reputation Manager Germany (d/f/m)ABOUT THE JOBYou will lead the Corporate Affairs agenda in Germany, protecting and enhancing the reputation of the business through public affairs, trade association work, stakeholder engagement and issues management. You will help the business grow and move through its transformation by making sure policymakers, industry bodies, media and other key stakeholders understand our positions on the food topics that matter most, from nutrition to packaging.You will be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Develop and implement the German Corporate Affairs strategy for Foods, aligned to business priorities and the global Corporate Affairs direction. - Partner with the German Foods leadership team to spot external risks and opportunities early, so that Corporate Affairs shapes business decisions from the start. - With support from European Corporate Affairs, build and maintain relationships with policymakers, trade associations, media, and other key stakeholders. Represent Foods in relevant forums and committees and advance our advocacy on priority issues such as supply chain fairness, nutrition and reformulation, sustainability and packaging, innovation and responsible marketing. - Monitor political, regulatory and stakeholder developments and assess implications for Foods and its reputation. - Lead local issues management, crisis preparedness and reputation protection, so that emerging risks are identified and managed effectively. - Be a trusted advisor to business leaders on stakeholder engagement, communications and external positioning. - With support from Global Media Relations, manage media enquiries with timely, accurate and aligned responses that protect and strengthen Foods' reputation. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Significant experience (typically 7+ years) in corporate affairs, public affairs or communications, gained in a company, trade association, agency, political office or newsroom. - Strong understanding of the German political, policy, regulatory and trade association landscape, ideally with experience in food, nutrition, consumer or sustainability issues. - Proven ability to represent business positions externally and work through trade associations to shape credible, evidence-based policy engagement. - Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with with the ability to build strong external networks. - Excellent written and spoken German and English, with strong presentation and writing skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience managing reputation, stakeholder engagement and communications within a complex organization; experience working through business transformation is a plus. - Calm, sound judgement under pressure and on sensitive issues. - Confidence with digital tools, including AI-supported monitoring and content, used responsibly.  WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great!
